question: Write a detailed explanation of section 9.1.1 “Digestion in human beings”, using the textbook evidence and supporting details.
answer: Let us trace the journey of food inside our body as it passes through diﬀ erent parts of the alimentary canal. Beginning with the mouth cavity The journey of the food you eat begins when it enters your mouth. Your teeth break down food you eat into smaller pieces by the processes of crushing and chewing.
